jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Search
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Quillstone Health

Quillstone Health is a fictional company used only in jobhunt's test fixtures. We build tools that help small teams ship reliable software.

The role

As a Machine Learning Engineer, Search on the Search Relevance team you will design, build and operate production systems, work closely with product and data partners, and own your work end to end.

  • Build and maintain services used by thousands of customers.
  • Improve quality through testing, reviews and monitoring.
  • Mentor teammates and write clear design docs.

What we offer

Flexible hours, learning budget & health cover.
